tool_arguments.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Fresh new production-quality transparent RGBA illustration: exactly FOUR full-body poses in a strict 2 by 2 row-major grid of the exact Hamilton Turtle adopted in image1. Image1 is identity/style/proportion reference only, not an edit target. Highest native resolution available. Preserve precisely its head-to-torso ratio, torso length/thickness, face, eye format, palette, warm brown line character, gentle clean watercolor paper texture, distinctive markings, horns/ears/bill/tail and original limb count. Generous transparent margins around each complete subject. No text, labels, border, grid lines, floor, shadows, background, props, clothing, effects, sparkles or extra animals. Keep the lightly anthropomorphic upright short-legged mascot and original arm-like forelimbs; do not revert to a natural quadruped. All subjects use the SAME head/body size and body reference; only the specified gesture changes. Do not fit or enlarge bent poses. 1 BLINK: Exact ordinary resting reference stance, proportions and anatomical support with ONLY eyelids gently fully closed as simple curves. Keep skull top, torso length and thickness, belly, resting forelimbs, legs and support unchanged. Do not squat, shrink the torso, inflate the head, lower the skull, lift the resting arms or feet. On the 1254 square full canvas reproduce the image1 placement as closely as possible. 2 GREET: A connected existing forelimb/wing/fin gently raised in a small friendly greeting, same supported or floating body stance. 3 PRESENT_RIGHT: Indicate viewer RIGHT with gaze and a connected existing forelimb/wing/fin; clearly rightward teaching gesture, preserve asymmetric markings, no mirrored copy. 4 THINK: Curious pondering small head tilt, existing forelimb close to chin where this anatomy permits; otherwise a small head/bill down tilt with natural resting wing/fin. Species constraints: 海亀の遊泳フリッパーへ変えない。顔を殻内へ消したり頭の大きさを縮めたりせず、甲羅の斑・腹板を維持する。 Finish with clear clean face/contours and connected complete appendages, without smudges, patchy pigment blobs, doubled parts, jagged alpha halos or clipping. Open eyes preserve reference design with no new glints. Every single part stays visible within its own transparent area. This replaces only the listed failing pose(s); preserve the reference identity and do not create other states. Critical adopted anatomy: each forepaw is a single smooth rounded flipper-like mitten with exactly THREE small cream oval claw marks at its distal end. NO projecting thumb, no palm, no fingers or human wrist. Exactly two of these rounded forepaws and two short rounded hind feet. Keep turtle head, body and shell proportions unchanged. All four cells have equal shared head and body size.
